n1.gs.eins.vertrauen.person: I want to speak frankly with you: where do we stand, and what do you expect of me?
n1.gs.eins.vertrauen: I wanted a quiet word with you about “{titel}”, off the record.
n1.gs.eins.rat.zusage: How should we handle this promise? I need your honest assessment.
n1.gs.eins.rat: What do you advise on “{titel}”? I need figures, not platitudes.
n1.gs.eins.auftrag: I am giving you an assignment: “{titel}” must improve, measurably, by the deadline.
n1.gs.eins.kritik: “{titel}” is not working. I expect you to put it right, and soon.
n1.gs.eins.belohnung: Your work stands out. I want you to get more funds for it, and I want people to know.
n1.gs.eins.rueckendeckung: I am telling you and the public: I stand behind you.
n1.gs.eins.machtfrage: I need clarity: are you with me or against me?
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.gut.nuechtern: Thank you for taking the time. I will tell you how I see things, and you tell me what you need.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.gut.eitel: It is good that you see it. I have achieved a few things that never made the papers.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.gut.streng: Good. If we are speaking openly, I can also tell you where I do not go along.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.gut.loyal: You can rely on me, you know that. But it is good to hear it said.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.gut.vorsichtig: I appreciate that. We should talk like this more often, before something goes wrong.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.gut.machtbewusst: That is wise of you. Whoever talks to me has less trouble with me.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.schlecht.nuechte: That is kind, but it does not change the figures.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.schlecht.eitel: I expected more than a quick word in passing.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.schlecht.streng: Kind words. I would prefer decisions.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.schlecht.loyal: I hear you, but I can tell something stands between us.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.schlecht.vorsich: I am not sure that is enough. Too much has built up.
n1.gs.antwort.vertrauen.schlecht.machtbe: Nice that you are talking. But I will remember what happened.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.gut.nuechtern: Here are the figures. Let me walk you through them as I see them.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.gut.eitel: Well, this is my field. I have had a plan for a long time.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.gut.streng: Short and clear: these are the steps; everything else is decoration.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.gut.loyal: I will tell you what I really think, even if it is not pleasant.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.gut.vorsichtig: I would not rush anything. But these are the steps I consider sound.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.gut.machtbewusst: You want the shortest way? Here it is. It is not cheap.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.schlecht.nuechtern: I have no reliable figures on that.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.schlecht.eitel: That is not my department; ask someone else.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.schlecht.streng: I will say nothing about it until I know how it will be used.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.schlecht.loyal: I would like to help, but I know no better than you.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.schlecht.vorsichtig: I would rather not commit myself before things are clearer.
n1.gs.antwort.rat.schlecht.machtbewusst: Advice is for those who take me seriously.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.gut.nuechtern: Understood. By the deadline I will bring you figures, not excuses.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.gut.eitel: That is a task that suits me. People will talk about me.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.gut.streng: I will take it on. Anyone in the way will notice.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.gut.loyal: You can count on me. I will not let you down.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.gut.vorsichtig: I accept. I will tell you in good time if things get tight.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.gut.machtbewusst: Good. If I succeed, I expect you not to forget it.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.schlecht.nuechtern: I accept the assignment, but I think the target is too high.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.schlecht.eitel: I am not sure I am the right person for this.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.schlecht.loyal: I will try. I cannot promise it.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.schlecht.vorsichti: I accept, but I advise patience.
n1.gs.antwort.auftrag.schlecht.machtbewu: I will do it. But remember that I do not do it gladly.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.gut.nuechtern: The criticism is fair. I will draw the consequences and report back in a month.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.gut.eitel: I see it differently, but I will prove it.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.gut.streng: Understood. I should have said so earlier.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.gut.loyal: You are right, and it hurts. I will put it right.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.gut.vorsichtig: I take that seriously. But I need more room to manoeuvre.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.gut.machtbewusst: Fine, I understand. But hold yourself to the same standard.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.schlecht.nuechtern: I consider that unfair, and I will put it on record.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.schlecht.eitel: I have done more for this country than many of those who accuse me.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.schlecht.streng: You forget the conditions I work under.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.schlecht.loyal: I never thought I would hear that from you of all people.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.schlecht.vorsichtig: I cannot work like this. I need support, not reproaches.
n1.gs.antwort.kritik.schlecht.machtbewus: I will remember that. Everything has its price.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.gut.nuechtern: Thank you. I will put the funds where they do the most good.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.gut.eitel: At last someone sees it. You will not regret it.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.gut.streng: I accept, on condition that the others do not pay for it.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.gut.loyal: I did not expect that, and I will not forget it.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.gut.vorsichtig: I am grateful. I hope the others do not see it as favouritism.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.gut.machtbewusst: I accept it, and I expect it will not be the last gesture.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.schlecht.nuechte: Thank you, but money is no substitute for trust.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.schlecht.eitel: Recognition is nice, but I had counted on a higher position.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.schlecht.streng: Do not settle with money what a conversation should resolve.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.schlecht.loyal: That is not necessary; I did not do it for the money.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.schlecht.vorsich: I accept, though I know how it looks.
n1.gs.antwort.belohnung.schlecht.machtbe: A start. But I want more than a gift.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.gut.nuechte: That helps me more right now than you know.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.gut.eitel: It is good to know one is noticed.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.gut.streng: I will not forget this gesture. I know what it costs.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.gut.loyal: You have no idea how much this means to me. I will not disappoint you.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.gut.vorsich: Thank you. That reassures me, and it reassures my ministry.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.gut.machtbe: Wise of you. You know what a favour is worth.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.schlecht.nu: Well meant, but the accusations remain.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.schlecht.ei: Backing is not enough; I want public satisfaction.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.schlecht.lo: Thank you. But I fear it comes too late.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.schlecht.vo: I am not sure whether this calms the situation or makes it worse.
n1.gs.antwort.rueckendeckung.schlecht.ma: The backing comes too late, and it no longer helps much.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.gut.nuechtern: I am with you. You need not have asked, but I understand why.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.gut.eitel: If it must be: with you. But you will have to remember it.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.gut.streng: I am with you as long as you lead.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.gut.loyal: With you, of course. That was never in question.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.gut.vorsichtig: I am staying. But I ask that we never do this again.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.schlecht.nuecht: Then I will go. I do not accept conditions.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.schlecht.eitel: If you ask like that, you know the answer. You will hear from me.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.schlecht.streng: Not under such conditions. I am returning my office.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.schlecht.loyal: That you ask like this tells me everything. I resign.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.schlecht.vorsic: I see no way forward. I am handing in my resignation.
n1.gs.antwort.machtfrage.schlecht.machtb: You asked the question. You will live with the answer.

n1.nf.notiz.kommRuecktritt: Appointed on an acting basis after the resignation of {alt}
n1.nf.folge.kommissarisch: An acting head runs the ministry and achieves less until a successor is appointed.
n1.nf.log.entlassen: The President dismisses {alt} and {art, select, ernennt {appoints {neu}} other {installs {neu} on an acting basis}}.
n1.nf.log.entlassen.whyFinanzen: Markets react nervously to a change at the Finance Ministry.
n1.nf.log.entlassen.why: A cabinet change costs capital and makes enemies.
n1.nf.ergebnis.entlassen: {alt} is dismissed; {neu} {art, select, ernennt {takes over} other {serves on an acting basis}}.
n1.nf.log.ernennt: The President appoints {rolle} {name} as permanent head, in place of {alt}.
n1.nf.log.ernennt.why: A permanent successor settles in and brings backing.
n1.nf.log.ruecktritt.why: {grund}. An acting head takes over; the markets and the press are watching for the successor.
n1.nf.auspacken.text: {titel}: in interviews and a book, the former {amt} describes the inner workings of the government.
n1.nf.auspacken.why: Whoever leaves in a quarrel takes what they know with them; trust in the government falls.
n1.nf.auspacken.ausgang: The revelations damage the government's standing: trust and legitimacy fall.
n1.mb.ziel.label: Set a target
n1.mb.ziel.kurz: A measurable target for the ministry, assessed after six months.
n1.mb.vorhaben.label: Prepare legislation
n1.mb.vorhaben.kurz: The minister drafts the bill and introduces it. You save attention.
n1.mb.verhandeln.label: Delegate negotiations
n1.mb.verhandeln.kurz: The Foreign Ministry conducts the talks with the country.
n1.mb.angebot.vorhaben.text: Affects {wirkt}; the bill costs {pk, number} capital.
n1.mb.grund.beschaeftigt: {name} is still working on an order.
n1.mb.grund.zuViele: {n, number} orders are already under way; neither you nor the ministers can keep track of more.
n1.mb.risiko.weigerung: {name} has about a {p, number} per cent chance of refusing: loyalty is {loy, number} (from 55 upwards {g, select, f {she} other {he}} always follows orders).
n1.mb.grund.keineGroesse: The indicator to measure against is missing.
n1.mb.grund.keinZiel: There is currently no measurable target for this.
n1.mb.risiko.gespraech: The order goes through a meeting: at most {n, number} appointments in thirty days.
n1.mb.grund.schonGesetz: A bill on this measure is already before parliament.
n1.mb.grund.nichtMoeglich: That is not possible at the moment.
n1.mb.folge.vorbereiten: {name} prepares “{massnahme}” from level {von} to {nach} (about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}).
n1.mb.folge.parlament: Then the bill goes to parliament: {pk, number} capital; {fehlt, select, ja {{luecke, plural, one {about # vote is} other {about # votes are}} missing in parliament today} other {the majority is there today}}.
n1.mb.folge.aufmerksamkeit: You pay {att, number} attention now instead of {voll, number}; the capital is due only when the bill is introduced.
n1.mb.risiko.vorhaben: There is about a {p, number} per cent chance that the draft fails in interministerial consultation; the attention is then lost.
n1.mb.grund.keineHandlung: This action is not available towards this country.
n1.mb.grund.gehtNicht: That is not possible right now.
n1.mb.folge.verhandeln: {name} takes on “{aktion}” with {land} (about {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}).
n1.mb.folge.verhandeln.kapital: The capital ({pk, number}) is due only on completion; you pay only half the attention.
n1.mb.risiko.verhandeln: There is about a {p, number} per cent chance that the talks fail and relations with {land} suffer slightly.
n1.mb.fehler.kapital: That needs {pk, number} capital, which you do not have.
n1.mb.weigert.text: {name} refuses: {g, select, f {she} other {he}} will not carry out “{titel}”.
n1.mb.weigert.drohung: {g, select, f {She} other {He}} is talking openly about resigning.
n1.mb.rm.verweigert.text: “{titel}”: {name} no longer follows the President in everything (loyalty {loy, number}).{drohung}
n1.mb.rm.verweigert.rat: A conversation, recognition or backing will bring loyalty back.
n1.mb.weigert.why: Below loyalty 55, the risk grows that a minister refuses orders.
n1.mb.uebernimmt.why: Result in about {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}; the attention ({att, number}) has been spent, and the capital is due only on completion.
n1.mb.rueckmeldungIn: Report back in about {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
n1.mb.verfaellt: The minister is no longer in office; the order lapses.
n1.mb.vorhaben.gescheitert: The draft failed in interministerial consultation (ministry performance {p, number} per cent).
n1.mb.rm.gescheitert.text: “{titel}” did not get through interministerial consultation.
n1.mb.rm.gescheitert.rat: With more backing and funding for the ministry, the chances improve next time.
n1.mb.rm.eingebracht.ersparnis: You save {n, number} attention compared with doing it yourself.
n1.mb.rm.liegtVor.text: “{titel}” is ready, but it cannot be introduced at the moment: {text}
n1.mb.rm.liegtVor.rat: You can introduce the bill later, as soon as it is possible.
n1.mb.rm.verhandelnGescheitert.text: “{titel}” did not come about; relations with {land} have suffered slightly.
n1.mb.log.rueckmeldung: Report from {rolle} {name}: {erg, select, erfolg {done} teilerfolg {partly done} other {failed}} — {titel}.
n1.pm.log.erfuellt.why: Those who deliver become more loyal; successes in the ministry add to legitimacy.
n1.pm.log.verfehlt.why: A missed target costs loyalty and breeds resentment: whoever misses a target is quick to blame the President.
